checks.name: compose stack healthy
control plane container has no Blender and no LibreOffice

worker network is internal (no route out of the host)
workers cannot reach the internet
published port binds to 127.0.0.1 only
Blender, Office and code workers registered
Blender artifact created on a worker
remote edit produced a checked revision
render preview produced by the worker and served by the control plane
every Blender job ran on the Blender worker
components exist after publication
research pipeline succeeded with all adapter work on workers
node wb resolved to cloud_cpu
node doc resolved to cloud_cpu
node deck resolved to cloud_cpu
formulas recalculated by LibreOffice inside the office worker
cross-artifact dependencies synced remotely
code artifact created on the code worker
allowlisted tests ran on the code worker and passed
a command the project allows but the WORKER's allowlist does not is not executed
the slow worker leased the job
request completed after the worker was killed
job retried (attempt 2) and succeeded on another worker
lease expiry recorded in the job's event history
the partitioned-to-be worker leased the job
request completed despite the partition
the partitioned worker's late result was rejected and audited
exactly one result published for the job
an apply job is running on a worker when the control plane restarts
control plane back after restart
interrupted execution resumed and succeeded

node log records the resumption
resumption audited
